name: 17_pour_from_bottle
title: Pouring Liquid and Repositioning Objects
summary: A robotic arm pours liquid into a glass, hides the glass by placing the bottle directly in front of it, slides a coaster, and then restores the bottle to reveal the glass.
robot: one white arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a white table in a brightly lit room

source.original_prompt: tilt the bottle to pour liquid

segments.instruction: The robot reaches for the glass bottle, grasps it, and lifts it toward the small glass. The camera remains fixed.
The robot tilts the bottle to pour liquid into the glass, turns it upright, and places it down on the right.
The robot regripps the bottle and lifts it off the table.
The robot places the bottle directly in front of the glass, completely blocking it from view.
segments.memory_event: hide: the glass is occluded behind the bottle

segments.instruction: The robot reaches to the black coaster on the left edge and slides it toward the center.
The robot aligns the black coaster on the table surface and releases it.
The robot grasps the bottle and sets it back on the right side of the table.
segments.memory_event: return: the small glass reappears containing liquid, upright and undisturbed

segments.instruction: The robot releases the bottle and retracts the arm upward to a resting position.
